overall: MARGINAL overall: a split sea. West and central are fishable, the east is not
limiterDetail: Main limiter is wind on the east grounds (ENE 20–21 kt, gusts 27–28 at Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot; Ciron and Barangonan 19.6 kt). Current is the limiter at Tara (1.3 kt), Turda (1.0 kt). Rain is minor. 9.7 kt is about 18 kph, the line fishermen treat as bad.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR (feed OK, no gale/TCWS/heavy-rain alert for Calamian/MIMAROPA; latest items are Luzon/Caraga advisories). Supporting only.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: Better in the west and central grounds: 4 GOOD / 5 MARGINAL / 4 POOR / 3 VERY POOR (was 1 GOOD / 7 MARGINAL / 8 POOR / 0 VERY POOR). Wind eased to 5 kt at Coron, Galoc and Panlaitan, so Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay and Panlaitan are GOOD. The east is worse: Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot are VERY POOR (20–21 kt, gusts to 28).
Supply: still normal to softening through Sun 29, no surge. Shortage detector ELEVATED (guide only). PAGASA is CLEAR for Calamian/MIMAROPA.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF. Shortage detector ELEVATED (Mon–Sun, guide only). Tightening risk: east grounds today, all week, peaking Thu 26. Supply from the west and central grounds should hold up better today. No surge expected.

bestWindow.headline: Now through morning, west and central grounds
details: Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay and Panlaitan are GOOD now (5–7 kt). Go early. Wind and current build toward evening. Keep small boats off Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan (19–21 kt, gusts to 28). Model's lowest-score hour is ~Tue 12 AM (Decabobo, Panlaitan), but the model rates that hour VERY POOR region-wide, so don't plan on it.
